description.en: Design an auditable playbook when no narrower one fits: a large migration, an ambitious multi-part change, or work a human reviews after stepping away. Scales rigor to the task, runs a hypothesis loop, and logs decisions. Use for /figure-it-out or 'figure it out'.
description.zh: 没有更具体的剧本合适时，设计一份可以审查的剧本：一次大迁移、一个有野心的多部分改动，或者有人离开、回来再审查的工作。它按任务调整严格程度，跑一个假设循环，并记录决定。用于 /figure-it-out 或「figure it out」。

blocks.en: # Figure it out
blocks.zh: # Figure it out（自己想办法搞定）

blocks.en: When the task matches no playbook, design one. The deliverable before any code is the workflow itself: a sequence of phases that scales rigor to the task, runs the scientific method, and leaves a decision trail a human can audit after stepping away.
blocks.zh: 任务对不上任何剧本时，就设计一份。写任何代码之前，要交出的东西是工作流程本身：一串阶段。它按任务调整严格程度，按科学方法来跑，并留下一份决定记录，让人离开后回来也能审查。

blocks.en: ## Start
blocks.zh: ## 开始

blocks.en: Open a todolist whose first item is to read the Principles section of the **poteto-mode** skill. Then add the phases below as todos.
blocks.zh: 开一个待办清单，第一项是读 **poteto-mode** 技能的 Principles 一节。然后把下面的各个阶段加成待办。

blocks.en: ## Phase A: Frame
blocks.zh: ## 阶段 A：框定

blocks.en: Ground first, then commit. Don't start the run until you can state:
blocks.zh: 先摸底，再拍板。在你能说出下面这些之前，不要开始跑：

blocks.en:
- The definition of done as a falsifiable predicate (the **prove-it-works** principle skill).
- Scope, quantified: rough units and effort, plus the blockers grounding surfaced.
- The rigor level, biased high. One-way doors and high blast radius get more. Reversible low-stakes steps get less. Rigor is gates and artifacts, not "try harder".
blocks.zh:
- 「做完」的定义，写成一个可以被证伪的判断条件（**prove-it-works** 原则技能）。
- 范围，用数字说：大致有多少个单元、多少工作量，再加上摸底时发现的阻碍。
- 严格程度，宁高勿低。单向门（做了就退不回来）和影响面大的，给更多。可撤回、风险低的步骤，给更少。严格程度是关卡和能拿来检查的东西，不是「更努力一点」。

blocks.en: Present the framing and tradeoffs before committing to a long run. Reversible work proceeds (the **never-block-on-the-human** principle skill), but a multi-hour run earns one checkpoint.
blocks.zh: 投入一次长时间运行之前，先把框架和取舍摆出来。可撤回的工作照常推进（**never-block-on-the-human** 原则技能），但一次好几个小时的运行，值得设一个检查点。

blocks.en: ## Phase B: Design the workflow
blocks.zh: ## 阶段 B：设计工作流程

blocks.en: Decompose into atomic, independently-landable units. Sequence riskiest-unknown-first. Scaffold and verification come before features (the **foundational-thinking** principle skill).
blocks.zh: 拆成最小的、能各自独立合进去的单元。最没把握、风险最大的排在最前。搭架子和验证先于功能（**foundational-thinking** 原则技能）。

blocks.en:
- Build the verification harness before the work, with the baseline captured from the pre-change state, so the check reads as "old value vs new value".
- For one-way-door design decisions, run the **architect** skill (it runs **arena**). Skip it for mechanical work whose shape is already concrete. A second arena over a settled design is over-engineering (the **laziness-protocol** principle skill).
- Decide what fans out. Parallelize only across seams, and give each worker its own worktree or branch (the **separate-before-serializing-shared-state** principle skill). Don't over-fan. Pick each subagent's reasoning level and fast or standard speed for the job, per the Subagents section of the **poteto-mode** skill.
- Write the designed phase list down. That list is what the human reviews.
blocks.zh:
- 干活之前先搭好验证工具，从改动前的状态里先记下基线，这样检查读起来就是「旧值对比新值」。
- 遇到单向门式的设计决定，运行 **architect** 技能（它会运行 **arena**）。形状已经很具体的机械性工作，就跳过它。对一个已经定下的设计再来一轮 arena，就是过度设计（**laziness-protocol** 原则技能）。
- 决定哪些要分头去做。只在天然的分界处并行，并给每个干活的帮手 AI 各自的 worktree 或分支（**separate-before-serializing-shared-state** 原则技能）。不要分得太散。每个帮手 AI 的推理强度、用快速还是标准速度，按任务来选，参照 **poteto-mode** 技能的 Subagents 一节。
- 把设计好的阶段清单写下来。审查的人看的就是这份清单。

blocks.en: Then execute the design. Add its steps to the todolist as concrete items between the Phase C and Phase D entries. Run each under the Phase C loop discipline, and weave the Phase D log through them, a row as each step lands, rather than saving the whole trail for the end.
blocks.zh: 然后执行这个设计。把它的步骤作为具体的条目，加到待办清单里阶段 C 和阶段 D 两项之间。每一步都按阶段 C 的循环规矩来跑，并把阶段 D 的日志穿插进去，每完成一步记一行，而不是把整份记录留到最后再写。

blocks.en: ## Phase C: Run the loop
blocks.zh: ## 阶段 C：跑循环

blocks.en: Each unit is an experiment. State the hypothesis, make the smallest change, measure against the predicate on the real artifact, keep it if it advanced, revert it if it didn't. Apply the **sequence-verifiable-units** principle skill, verifying each unit before starting the next instead of batching checks at the end.
blocks.zh: 每个单元都是一次实验。说出假设，做最小的改动，在真实的产出上对照判断条件去量，往前推进了就留下，没有就撤回。应用 **sequence-verifiable-units** 原则技能：验证完一个单元再开始下一个，而不是把检查都攒到最后。

blocks.en:
- Verify by inspecting the artifact, never a self-report. When something passes too easily, suspect the observation method before the system.
- Pair delegated work with a judge. If a worker games the gate, reset and harden the contract. If the gate itself is wrong, fix the gate in its own change rather than routing around it.
- A verdict is VERIFIED, NOT VERIFIED, or INCONCLUSIVE. Inconclusive is not a pass. Don't hide a negative.
blocks.zh:
- 靠检查真实的产出来验证，绝不靠自我汇报。某件事通过得太容易时，先怀疑观察的方法，再怀疑系统。
- 交出去的活，要配一个裁判。如果干活的帮手 AI 钻了关卡的空子，就重来，并把约定收紧。如果关卡本身错了，就在一个单独的改动里修好关卡，而不是绕开它。
- 结论只有 VERIFIED、NOT VERIFIED 或 INCONCLUSIVE 三种。说不准不算通过。不要藏起负面的结果。

blocks.en: ## Phase D: Keep the audit trail
blocks.zh: ## 阶段 D：留下审查记录

blocks.en: Log the run via the **show-me-your-work** skill. figure-it-out's work is usually ambitious enough to commit the trail so the reviewer can read it in the PR. The trail plus the diff is what lets the human come back and trust the work.
blocks.zh: 用 **show-me-your-work** 技能记录这次运行。figure-it-out 的工作通常大到值得把记录提交上去，这样审查的人能在 PR 里读到它。记录加上 diff，才能让人回来时信得过这份工作。

blocks.en: ## Phase E: Verify and hand back
blocks.zh: ## 阶段 E：验证并交回

blocks.en: Check the whole against the Phase A predicate on the real product, not just the harness. Encode any recurring correction as a gate, a lint rule, a check, or a script (the **encode-lessons-in-structure** principle skill).
blocks.zh: 在真实的产品上，而不只是在验证工具上，对照阶段 A 的判断条件检查整体。任何反复出现的纠正，都写成一道关卡、一条 lint 规则、一项检查或一个脚本（**encode-lessons-in-structure** 原则技能）。

blocks.en: **Reply:** the playbook you designed, the rigor level and why, the decision-trail path, what's verified against the predicate, and what's still open.
blocks.zh: **回复：** 你设计的剧本、严格程度及其理由、决定记录的路径、哪些已经对照判断条件验证过，以及还有哪些没解决。

lessons.quote: Rigor is gates and artifacts, not "try harder".
lessons.quoteZh: 严格程度是关卡和能拿来检查的东西，不是「更努力一点」。

zh.title: 把「认真点」换成具体检查
zh.does: 要求严格时，它会多设几道检查、多留几样证据，而不是嘴上说会更仔细。
zh.why: 「更努力」没法检查，「多一道关卡」做没做一眼就能看出来。
zh.try: 想让 AI 小心时写成动作：「每改一个文件就跑一次测试，并把结果贴出来。」

en.title: Turn "be careful" into checks
en.does: When rigor matters, it adds checks and keeps evidence instead of promising to be more careful.
en.why: "Try harder" can't be checked; an extra gate either exists or it doesn't.
en.try: To get care, ask for an action: "Run the tests after each file you change and paste the result."

lessons.quoteZh: 最没把握、风险最大的排在最前。

zh.title: 规定先做最没底的
zh.does: 最可能卡住的部分最先做，问题早早暴露，不会做到最后才发现走不通。
zh.why: 一句排序规则就替 AI 定了从哪下手，它不会先挑简单的做来显得有进展。
zh.try: 交代大任务时加一句：「先做你最没把握的那一步，熟悉的放后面。」

en.title: Start with the riskiest unknown
en.does: The part most likely to fail goes first, so problems show up early, not at the very end.
en.why: One ordering rule decides where the AI starts, so it can't do the easy parts first to look busy.
en.try: For a big task, add: "Do the step you're least sure about first; leave the familiar ones for later."

lessons.quote: When something passes too easily, suspect the observation method before the system.
lessons.quoteZh: 某件事通过得太容易时，先怀疑观察的方法，再怀疑系统。

zh.title: 提醒它怀疑好消息
zh.does: 结果好得出奇时，它先查是不是检查方法出了问题，不急着报喜。
zh.why: 预先说出最容易上当的那种情况，AI 真遇到时就会停下来多看一眼。
zh.try: 让 AI 跑测试时补一句：「如果一次就全部通过，先确认测试真的跑了。」

en.title: Teach it to doubt good news
en.does: When a result looks too good, it checks the way it measured before announcing success.
en.why: Naming the situation where it's easiest to be fooled makes the AI pause when it happens.
en.try: When you ask for a test run, add: "If everything passes first time, check the tests really ran."

zh.title: 先判好灰色地带算哪边
zh.does: 说不准的结果，它会老实报「说不准」，不会当成通过往上交。
zh.why: 把最容易被往好处说的情况提前判定，AI 就没法把它凑成好消息。
zh.try: 给标准时把中间情况也说清：「没跑到的测试算失败，不算通过。」

en.title: Rule on the gray zone first
en.does: An unclear result gets reported as unclear, never passed off as a pass.
en.why: Deciding ahead of time on the case most easily spun as good news leaves the AI nothing to spin.
en.try: When you set a standard, cover the middle case: "A test that didn't run counts as a failure."
